description: AI4Fire version-1 run manifest: reported response files, supporting repeat and repair files, and historic archives.

historic.reason: Earlier runs kept as evidence of the output-cap defect: runs executed under a 200-token completion cap before the cap was raised to 1536 tokens across tasks.
Earlier runs kept as evidence of the first analogue pool: grounded allocation runs conducted before the eligibility rule required both analogue days to precede the report day.

excluded_from_reported.reason: Historic 1024-pixel resolution arm run during resolution sensitivity checks before standardizing on native 1568-pixel frames.
Historic 1024-pixel resolution arm run during resolution sensitivity checks before standardizing on native 1568-pixel frames.

baselines.reason: Trained non-LLM baselines on the same items and the same displayed information; written by baselines/mesogeos_trained.py and baselines/allocation_trained.py.

prompt_variants.reason: Prompt-sensitivity runs of run_mesogeos.py --variant p1 and p2, bare condition; scored by analysis/prompt_sensitivity.py.

retrieval_v2.reason: Grounded allocation runs under the movement-conditioned analogue rule (run_allocation.py --rule v2); scored by analysis/retrieval_v2.py.

tooluse.reason: Fire data tool-use runs on FPA-FOD (run_tooluse.py), bare and tool arms, 156 items; scored by analysis/tooluse_paired.py.

wildfirevqa.reason: Temperature-grounded aerial question answering on WildFireVQA over FLAME 3 imagery (run_wildfirevqa.py), bare and grounded arms, 408 items over 390 frames; scored by analysis/wildfirevqa_paired.py; task-wildfirevqa/image-map.json maps each item to its frame.

added_models.reason: Model sweep of 2026-09-18: the added full-capability Bedrock models (tier 'added' in models.py) on personnel allocation, fire danger, and smoke detection, bare and grounded, same prompts and cap as the reported runs; their tool-use and aerial files sit in the tooluse and wildfirevqa sections.

text_models.reason: Model sweep of 2026-09-18: the text-only Bedrock models (tier 'text' in models.py) on personnel allocation and fire danger, bare and grounded; the three reasoning models ran at an 8,192-token cap recorded in usage.max_out; tool-use files of the tool-capable ones sit in the tooluse section.
